Instagram Reels Direct Upload Graph API

Complete step-by-step configuration guide to generate your Meta Graph API credentials and connect your account.

1

Convert to a Professional Account & Link a Facebook Page

Meta's Content Publishing API does not support personal Instagram accounts. Your Instagram profile must be a Business or Creator account linked to a Facebook Page you manage.

  1. Open the Instagram app, go to Settings and activity → Account type and tools, and tap Switch to professional account (choose either Creator or Business).
  2. If you do not already have a Facebook Page, create one at facebook.com/pages/create.
  3. Link them via Meta Business Suite → Instagram Accounts or in the Instagram mobile app under Edit profile → Page → Connect or create.
2

Create a Meta Developer App

You need a Meta App container to generate API access tokens and obtain your App ID and App Secret.

  1. Sign in to the Meta for Developers App Dashboard and click Create App.
  2. Enter an App Name (e.g., Reels Auto Publisher) and your contact email, then click Next.
  3. Under Use cases, select Other → click Next.
  4. Select Business as the app type → click Next, review details, and click Create app.
  5. Once inside your App Dashboard, go to App settings → Basic in the left sidebar. Copy your App ID and click Show to copy your App Secret for Step 4.
3

Generate Your Graph API Access Token (EAA...)

Use Meta's Graph API Explorer to generate a User Access Token authorized for Reels publishing.

  1. Open the Meta Graph API Explorer.
  2. In the right-hand panel under Meta App, select the app you just created in Step 2.
  3. Under User or Page, leave it set to User Token.
  4. Under Permissions, search for and add all five permissions below (click to copy):
instagram_basic
instagram_content_publish
pages_show_list
pages_read_engagement
business_management
  1. Click Generate Access Token. In the Facebook login popup, grant access to the exact Facebook Page and Instagram account you linked in Step 1.
  2. Copy the generated token string starting with EAA... from the top Access Token field.
Token Expiration Tip: Tokens generated directly in the Graph API Explorer expire after 1 hour. To convert it into a 60-day long-lived token immediately, paste it into the Meta Access Token Debugger, click Debug, and click Extend Access Token at the bottom of the page.
4

Fill In Your App Connection Settings

Map the credentials you collected into the four fields of your connection panel:

Form Field Status Where to Get Value
Meta Graph API Access Token Required Paste the EAA... User Access Token copied from the Graph API Explorer (or extended via the Token Debugger).
Instagram Business/Creator User ID Optional Leave blank to auto-detect from your linked Facebook Page. If you have multiple linked Pages, query me/accounts?fields=instagram_business_account in the Graph API Explorer and paste the 17-digit id.
Meta App ID Optional (Recommended) Found in Meta App Dashboard → App settings → Basic. Enables automatic 60-day token renewal.
Meta App Secret Optional (Recommended) Found next to App ID in App settings → Basic (click Show). Required alongside App ID to exchange short-lived tokens for 60-day tokens.
5

Quick Troubleshooting

  • "No Instagram Business account found": Ensure your Instagram account is switched to Business/Creator and that you selected both the Facebook Page and Instagram account during the OAuth consent popup in Step 3.
  • "Invalid OAuth access token" / Expired Token: Short-lived tokens expire in 60 minutes. Always provide your Meta App ID and Meta App Secret so the backend can exchange and refresh the token for 60 days.
  • Reels Upload Rejected: Instagram Graph API requires Reels videos to be hosted at a publicly accessible HTTPS URL (MP4/MOV, 9:16 aspect ratio recommended, 3 seconds to 15 minutes duration, max 1 GB).
